preconditions.description: The number of vertices n is between 2 and 100.
The number of edges is exactly n - 1.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= v <= n and 1 <= u <= n and v != u for v, u in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two distinct vertices within the range [1, n].

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly n integers.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= count <= 1000000007 for count in output)
postconditions.description: Each count in the output is a non-negative integer less than or equal to 1000000007.
The i-th integer in the output is the number of labeled trees with n vertices that share exactly i - 1 edges with Will's tree, modulo 1000000007.
